'''Terk Street''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] [[Sector 8D]]. In the time before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the criminal [[Nok Derrick]] was the owner of a hovel on Terk Street.
